items.name: Caballero de los Mares Lima 2024
items.information: Ver la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CaballerodelosMaresLima2024#48505-registro-registration) para obtener información detallada. Además, todos los competidores deben conocer [el reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) Debido a cuestiones de aforo, los participantes deben evitar asistir con invitados. See the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CaballerodelosMaresLima2024#48505-registro-registration) tab for detailed information. Also, all competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) Due to capacity limitations, participants should avoid attending with guests.

items.name: Stockholmsligan 279: Ett Hälsosamt Val - 2024

venue.name: Arena Satelliten
venue.details: Klubben. Entrance through "Entré A", in front of the bus stops. The front door might be locked, but we will open it at regular intervals - contact the organizers if you are stuck outside.

items.information: Varmt välkomna till den tredje deltävlingen i höstsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet (eller tidigare deltagande i serien). Mer information om Stockholmligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. -- A warm welcome to the third competition in the autumn season of Stockholmsligan 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information.
